title: Hector’s challenge
intro: Hector halts both armies, who sit down like a ruffled sea. He proposes a single combat to settle the war.

notes.text: ἦ ῥά νυ, surely now; πείθομαι + dat: 2sg aor opt mid, wish / polite request.
κασίγνητος, brother; τοι = σοι, to you, ethic dat. Helenus is Hector’s brother.
καθίζω, make sit: 2sg aor imperative.
προκαλέω, challenge: 2sg aor imperative mid, epic -σσ-.
ὅς τις, whoever; ἄριστος, best: superlative of ἀγαθός.
ἀντίβιον, face to face; μάχομαι aor inf, result / purpose.
μοῖρα, fate (ἐστί understood); πώ, as yet; τοι = σοι.
θνῄσκω, die: 2aor inf; ἐφέπω, meet / incur: 2aor inf ἐπισπεῖν; πότμον, doom (acc).
ὄψ, voice: acc ὄπα, elided; ἀκούω, hear: 1sg aor, without augment.
αἰειγενέτης, ever-living: gen pl, epic -άων, of the gods.
φημί, say: 3sg impf, aspirated before ἕκτωρ; χαίρω, rejoice: 3sg 2aor pass.
μῦθος, speech; ἀκούω aor ptc nom sg, “on hearing.”
ἐς μέσσον, into the middle; εἶμι, go: pres ptc; ἀνέργω, hold back: 3sg impf, uncontracted.
δόρυ, spear: gen sg of the part, grasping the spear by the middle; αἱρέω, take: 2aor ptc.
ἱδρύω, make sit / settle: 3pl aor pass.
κάδ = κατά by assimilation, tmesis; ἵζω, seat: 3sg aor, augment-like εἷ-.
ἀργυρότοξος, silver-bowed: epithet of Apollo.
ἕζομαι, sit: 3du aor; the two gods, Athena and Apollo.
ὄρνις, bird; αἰγυπιός, vulture: dat pl; ἔοικα, be like: perf ptc nom pl masc ἐοικότες + dat.
φηγός, oak; ὑψηλός, tall; ἐπί + dat, on.
αἰγίοχος, aegis-bearing: gen sg, epithet of Zeus.
τέρπομαι, take delight in: pres ptc + dat ἀνδράσι.
στίχες, rows; ἧμαι, sit: 3pl plpf / impf εἵατο; πυκνός, thick.
φρίσσω, bristle: perf ptc nom fem pl; dat of means ἀσπίσι, κορύθεσσι (κόρυς, helmet), ἔγχεσι.
οἷος, such as; χέω, pour out: 3sg aor mid, gnomic; ἔπι = ἐπί, anastrophe, after its noun.
Ζέφυρος, west wind: gen; φρίξ, ripple.
ὄρνυμι, rise: mid ptc gen sg, genitive absolute with Zephyr; νέον, newly.
μελαίνω, grow dark: 3sg pres; ὑπ᾽ αὐτῆς, under it, the ripple.
τοῖος, such: nom pl fem, correlative with οἵη; εἵατο, were seated.
μετά + dat, among; ἀμφότεροι, both; εἶπον 3sg 2aor with epic ε-.
κλύω, hear: reduplicated 2aor imperative 2pl; μευ = μου, gen with verb of hearing.
ὄφρα + aor subj: purpose; κελεύω, bid: 3sg pres; τά, the things (relative).
ὅρκιον, oath / treaty: nom pl neut; τελέω, fulfil: 3sg aor, epic -σσ-.
ὑψίζυγος, high-throned: epithet of Zeus.
φρονέω, devise: pres ptc; τεκμαίρομαι, ordain / plan: 3sg pres mid.
εἰς ὅ κε, until; αἱρέω, take: 2pl 2aor subj; εὔπυργος, well-towered.
δάμνημι, subdue: 2pl aor pass subj, epic lengthened; ποντοπόρος, sea-crossing: dat pl.
ἔασιν = εἰσίν, 3pl of εἰμί, with tmesis ἐν; Παναχαιῶν, of all the Achaeans.
partitive τῶν; ὅν τινα, whomever; ἄνωγα, bid / urge: pres 3sg, with inf μαχέσασθαι.
δεῦρο, here; εἶμι, go: 3sg imperative.
πρόμος, front-fighter / champion; ἔμμεναι = εἶναι, epic inf of purpose.
μυθέομαι, speak: 1sg pres; ἄμμε = ἡμῖν, Aeolic dat; ἐπιμάρτυρος, witness; ἔστω, 3sg imperative.
